text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(It's not my best distance... Something unexpected could happen.
It's a little scary... but still—)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...'For now,' then! Understood!
I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When we first met, she wasn't able to give it
her all. But after taking all this time—
she can finally shine."
choice_data_list: Give it everything and charge through! Flight!!
Give it everything and run through! Flight!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(You're okay, me. Now, let's have fun.
Step out with everything you've got, sprint, full power—)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Look at me...!
Watch me shine—!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, North Flight... is so fast...!!
—It's like she's flying...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Nnngh!!
This is so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
North Flight! What was that speed...!
That was incredibleee!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I knew it... I was right.
I'm so glad I believed in myself.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Racing...
suits me best of all!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me!
I was so very happy!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad... I was able to run
in the Shuka Sho today!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
On this grand stage, I'll run with everything I've got
and show everyone what I'm truly made of!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I clash with the brilliance of the other girls,
my own sparkle shines brighter and brighter!
Just like a diamond being polished...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight, visibly unable to hide her excitement.
I gently nod to each word spilling from her rapid-fire flurry—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I want to express who I am
so, so much more!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I took the plunge after all.
It makes me love my individuality even more.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Speed"...
I want to take pride in this individuality.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In the sprint division—
I can shine even brighter than a diamond, right?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I'll take my own royal road!
—I'm devoting myself to finding the best coordinates!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having decided to make the mile her core focus—the challenge of taking on the sprint/mile division is finally about to begin.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what race
Bakushin O-chan will run next.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to seriously committing to the sprint division,
the one you can't help but keep in mind is...
Sakura Bakushin O, the current sprint king.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what, I want to fight...
No, I have to fight."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"She wears... the purest outfit of all,
clad in speed itself."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: If I want to shine the brightest with my speed, I have to beat her.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that girl... as a model honor student,
she mentioned before that she wants to run in every single GⅠ race.”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So maybe next time,
it won't be a sprint race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by her words, I take out my smartphone.
Sakura Bakushin O always makes grand announcements about her next race,
so I found the article right away.
choice_data_list: Looks like the next one is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
!
The spring sprint GⅠ...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If the Sprinters Stakes crowns the autumn sprint champion, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen is the race that decides the spring sprint champion."
choice_data_list: Looks like we can still clash in the sprints.
Looks like we can still clash in the sprints, huh?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
our next target race is...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can face Bakushin O...
fully prepared.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Can I really win, I wonder?
choice_data_list: Let's figure out a winning outfit together!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, lately, Trainer...
you've been feeling awfully dependable.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I would love to consult with you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowawawah!?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you startled me.
What's up, Bakushin O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san is heading
to the Takamatsunomiya Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bakushin O is running too, after all.
Man, it's gonna be a heated battle between rivals.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Rivals...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Right? It feels like both of them
are kind of conscious of each other...
Flight-chan makes it especially obvious, huh?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"Standing alongside the King of Bakushin, the Fashion Queen!"
...Maybe an article like that will come out.
I can't wait—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"Wah!?
Wait, where are you going!?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Where could it be?! I don't know!
But...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I can't hold back the urge to Bakushin any longeeeer!!!
Chowaaaaaa--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Where the strongest Sprint King awaits—
our next target race is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen."
